name: Suspension Triceps Extension
steps: Face away from a suspension trainer anchor, grasp both handles with palms down, and lean forward with arms extended ahead of your shoulders.
Brace your abs and glutes firmly so your body forms a straight angled line from head to heels.
Bend strictly at the elbows to lower your forehead smoothly between your hands under control.
Press decisively through your palms to extend your elbows back straight while keeping your upper arms fixed.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked shoulder-width apart and pointing forward rather than flaring sideways.
Maintain tight core tension so your lower back does not arch at the bottom.
